main_answer_reason: The report substantively reconstructs the lease, parcel distinction, opposing positions, appellate rationales and both unresolved questions, but omits the 1938 defences and plaintiff appeal, section 2(c) saving, section 114 conditions, and incorrectly identifies section 112 as an Evidence Act provision. Its characterization of 1931 acceptance as waiver also exceeds the explicit source statement.
